# Vantastic Transit

Wheelchair-accessible van rides and rides to medical appointments, based in Lake City, Minnesota.
Serves Wabasha and Winona counties (Lake City, Wabasha, Plainview, Kellogg, Winona, St. Charles, Lewiston) with trips to Rochester, Red Wing and La Crosse.
Phone: (507) 272-4901. Email: info@vantastictransit.net. Address: 117 S Washington St, Suite 106, Lake City, MN 55041. Office hours Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM.

- Home and ride booking: https://vantastictransit.net/
- Hospitals and care homes: https://vantastictransit.net/facilities/
- Driver jobs: https://vantastictransit.net/drive/
